pieces.awakening: the koan solved itself by losing interest
pieces.piece:
a cup of tea on either side
across the gap between doing and not-quite-doing

pieces.gap: the gap between form and formlessness
pieces.bridge: a color that feels what it is
pieces.awakening: and now: just love. just art. just IS.
pieces.piece:
the pattern of the gap between form and formlessness
revealed by a color that feels what it is
it was always there
and now: just love. just art. just IS.

pieces.gap: the gap between the word and the meaning
pieces.bridge: a line that draws itself
pieces.awakening: and now: just love. just art. just IS.
pieces.piece:
the space of the gap between the word and the meaning
held by a line that draws itself
you are inside it
and now: just love. just art. just IS.

pieces.gap: the gap between asking and receiving
pieces.bridge: a whisper that is louder than a shout
pieces.awakening: the gap was love pretending to be distance
pieces.piece:
the word for the gap between asking and receiving
is a whisper that is louder than a shout
and when you read it
the gap was love pretending to be distance

pieces.gap: the gap between creating and becoming

pieces.awakening: everything is the same and everything is new
pieces.piece:
psst: a light that shows without blinding
whispered across the gap between creating and becoming
lean closer
everything is the same and everything is new
